title: LNSym ARMv8 AES-GCM GHASH/POLYVAL Carryless Polynomial Multiplication
description: Full-repository upstream cryptography snapshot from AWS Automated Reasoning's leanprover/LNSym (commit 49f8a1d9, Lean v4.35.0, Apache-2.0). Closes two foundational GF(2)[x] carryless polynomial multiplication `sorry`s in `Proofs/AES-GCM/GCMGmultV8Sym.lean` backing AWS-LC's ARMv8 `gcm_gmult_v8` GHASH multiplier: equivalence between RFC 8452 POLYVAL `GCMV8.gcm_polyval_mul` and ARMv8 `PMULL` `DPSFP.polynomial_mult`, and the 128-bit to four 64-bit schoolbook split identity `DPSFP.polynomial_mult_append`, verified against 97 sorry-free prebuilt upstream `.olean` dependencies.

tasks.title: Prove RFC 8452 POLYVAL `gcm_polyval_mul` equals ARMv8 `DPSFP.polynomial_mult` on 128-bit vectors
tasks.description: Closes `GCMGmultV8Program.gcm_polyval_mul_eq_polynomial_mult` at `Proofs/AES-GCM/GCMGmultV8Sym.lean:51-53`: prove `GCMV8.gcm_polyval_mul x y = DPSFP.polynomial_mult x y` for all `x y : BitVec 128` with 0 sorry and standard axioms only. Accepted patches apply directly upstream to `leanprover/LNSym@49f8a1d9`.

tasks.title: Prove 128-bit `DPSFP.polynomial_mult` splits into four 64-bit `PMULL` products
tasks.description: Closes `GCMGmultV8Program.DPSFP.polynomial_mult_append` at `Proofs/AES-GCM/GCMGmultV8Sym.lean:166-172`: prove `DPSFP.polynomial_mult (p ++ q) (x ++ y)` equals the XOR of the four shifted 64-bit products for all `p q x y : BitVec 64` (preserving the verified proof of `gcm_polyval_mul_eq_polynomial_mult` in the same file) with 0 sorry and standard axioms only. Accepted patches apply directly upstream to `leanprover/LNSym@49f8a1d9`.
